title: Observational study on the course of disease in patients with (suspected) chronic diseases of the upper and lower respiratory tract
summary: Establishment of an observational study to improve diagnosis and progression assessment of rare chronic lung diseases.
conditions: Other congenital malformations of respiratory system

interventions.name:
For all patients already diagnosed with or suspected of having chronic lung disease, a guideline-based, disease-specific examination plan. The examinations are repeated regularly on an individual basis as required.
- Medical history and clinical examination
- Acquisition of disease-specific anamne

In the healthy controls, only the non-invasive and painless functional examinations that can be performed without sedation (pulmonary function and ciliary diagnostics) and a medical history are taken.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Patients with (suspected) chronic lung disease
- Healthy control subjects without history or symptoms of lung disease
Exclusion criteria:
- Withdrawal from the study
- Other serious medical conditions
- medical findings that would reasonably be expected to compromise the safety of the patient or the quality of the study data
